categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies peer transaction request tracking, orphan reconsideration, and package relay liveness rules.
categories.rationale: Resolves multiple adversarial pinning and stalling vectors in 1p1c package relay where attackers can disconnect or exploit reject tracking to drop honest CPFP transactions. Resistance to relay stalling and DoS attacks in transaction propagation is category-critical for P2P and dependent protocols like Lightning.
